name: vane
description: Claude Code mod (plugin) that adds a side pane with Activity, Files, Agents, Context, MCP, Skills and Spend tabs, a status line above the prompt, a restyled chat, Mermaid diagrams in the terminal, tables, and code and diff panels. Colours follow both /color and the /theme (dark, light and others).

probe.description: Log per-component render time to the debug log every 200 renders
